author: Ari Koslow
title: James McCann goes yard twice Saturday
desc: James McCann went 2-for-4 with two home runs and four RBI in the Diamondbacks 9-2 win over the Dodgers on Saturday.
impact: McCann extended the Diamondbacks lead with a three-run homer off Yoshinobu Yamamoto. Despite this performance, he remains off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Pfaadt earns win Saturday
desc: Brandon Pfaadt allowed two runs on six hits over 5 1/3 innings with two strikeouts in a win on Saturday against the Dodgers.
impact: Pfaadt pitched well for the second straight outing in a tough matchup. He'll figure to continue to see more opportunities following the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ty France hits home run Saturday
desc: Ty France went 2-for-3 with a home run in the Padres 8-7 win over the Blue Jays on Saturday.
impact: France broke a 7-7 tie with a solo home run in the eighth inning. It wound up being the last run scored by either team in the game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Miller earns save Saturday
desc: Mason Miller earned the save on Saturday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Miller worked around one hit with two strikeouts. He threw just 14 pitches to earn his 24th save on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Buehler struggles Saturday
desc: Walker Buehler allowed four runs on three hits over two innings with one strikeout and four walks in a no-decision on Saturday against the Blue Jays.
impact: It was a rough game for the starting pitchers as Buehler and Trey Yesavage combined to walk 11 batters. Buehler will remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Gilbert takes loss Saturday
desc: Logan Gilbert allowed four runs on nine hits over 6 2/3 innings with five strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Saturday against the Rays.
impact: Gilbert left the game with two on and two outs in the seventh inning with both runners going on to score. He'll carry a 3.32 ERA into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Esmerlyn Valdez hits three home runs in doubleheader Saturday
desc: Esmerlyn Valdez went yard three times across Saturday's doubleheader against the Brewers.
impact: Valdez went yard twice with six RBI in Game 1. He followed that with another home run in Game 2. He is slashing .311/.370/.722 on the season with 10 home runs.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Montgomery earns save in Game 2 of doubleheader Saturday
desc: Mason Montgomery earned the save in Game 2 of Saturday's doubleheader against the Brewers.
impact: Montgomery got the opportunity after Gregory Soto logged the save in Game 1. He worked around a walk, striking out two to earn his first save of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bubba Chandler takes no-decision in Game 2 Saturday
desc: Bubba Chandler allowed two runs on five hits over 4 2/3 innings with six strikeouts and three walks in a no-decision in Game 2 of Saturday's doubleheader against the Brewers.
impact: Chandler allowed two runs in the fifth inning after tossing four scoreless frames. He will take a 4.77 ERA into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gregory Soto earns save in Game 1 of doubleheader Saturday
desc: Gregory Soto earned the save in Game 1 of Saturday's doubleheader against the Brewers.
impact: Soto was able to work around a jam on the basepaths to help the Pirates hold onto a 7-6 win. He is up to 12 saves on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Braxton Ashcraft struggles in Game 1 of doubleheader Saturday
desc: Braxton Ashcraft allowed five runs on five hits over five innings with six strikeouts and two walks in a no-decision in Game 1 of Saturday's doubleheader against the Brewers.
impact: Ashcraft struggled in his final start ahead of the All-Star break, allowing a pair of solo home runs. He'll take a 3.49 ERA into the break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Carson Kelly goes deep Saturday
desc: Carson Kelly went 2-for-4 with a home run, one run scored and one RBI in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds.
impact: Kelly hit a 410-foot solo homer off Nick Lodolo in the sixth inning. He has now gone deep in two of his last four games and owns a .250 AVG and 550 SLG in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Alex Bregman goes yard Saturday
desc: Alex Bregman went 1-for-4 with a home run, a walk, one run scored and two RBI in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds.
impact: After going hitless in three straight contests, Bregman snapped the skid by belting a two-run homer off Julian Garcia in the seventh inning. He is now slashing just .167/.244/.333 in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Michael Busch records three hits Saturday
desc: Michael Busch went 3-for-4 with a double and one run scored in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds.
impact: Busch recorded his second three-hit game of the season, with his first coming on Opening Day against the Washington Nationals. He has looked good at the plate lately, recording a hit in three of his last four games while posting a .350 OBP across 34 at-bats in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Javier Assad gives up two runs Saturday
desc: Javier Assad allowed two runs on sevent hits and no walks while striking out four across five innings in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Cincinnati Reds.
impact: The two runs Assad allowed came on back-to-back home runs to Nathaniel Lowe and Eugenio Suarez in the fourth inning. Aside from that, he turned in another solid outing and has surrendered just two earned runs across two starts in July. For the season, he owns a 4.11 ERA and 1.13 WHIP across 15 appearances.
